scenario_rules.rule: Parcel-specific contributing survey stays UNKNOWN until EA metadata-index evidence matches the parcel location.
Bilinear resampling is explicit derived processing and must not be described as native capture.
Primary measurement uses bare-earth DTM semantics; DSM object heights are excluded.
Classified ground points may differ from the manually edited final DTM and cannot be asserted identical.
Point-cloud density, raster resolution and vertical RMSE remain separate quantities.
EA absolute RMSE and relative/random error remain separate from repository confidence.
Historical comparisons require survey-specific transformation/geoid metadata from the index catalogue.
Rendered WMS preview is excluded from numeric sampling; raw coverage/raster access is required.
EPSG:27700 describes horizontal BNG and does not by itself prove the vertical datum.
ODN/OSGM15 vertical reference and transformation uncertainty remain distinct from LiDAR RMSE.
Terrain5 tile version/reason-for-change/lineage metadata is context, not parcel acquisition time.
Terrain5 grid and contours share source lineage but are not interchangeable measurement representations.
Terrain5 remains a secondary cross-check and does not alter the EA 1m primary result.
Title plan must be read with register and filed documents.
General title-plan extent is not promoted to an exact legal boundary.
A boundary agreement recorded in the register is not silently treated as a section-60 determined boundary.
Exact legal-boundary claims require determined-boundary evidence.
Determined-boundary plan measurement tolerances are legal-plan requirements, not LiDAR vertical accuracy.
GeoPackage tiled gridded coverage encoding does not validate terrain authority.
CRS WKT2 and coordinate epoch resolve reference semantics but do not identify survey capture date.
OGC API Processes outputs are derived unless explicitly proven to be native retrieval.
Coverage tiles can be generated by subsetting/resampling and therefore are not assumed native.
Interpolation method must be explicit when processing changes sample positions.
No business row or final-ready state is produced while required F-host receipts remain absent.
